name: zovo-apk-analyzer
displayName: APK Analyzer & APK Viewer (AndroidManifest, DEX Method Count, APK Size)
description: APK analyzer and APK viewer for VS Code: open an .apk file and read the decoded AndroidManifest.xml, permissions (dangerous ones flagged), exported activities and services, DEX method counts by package against the 65,536 limit, APK size by folder and file type, native ABIs and the signing certificate. Also reads .aab, .apks and .xapk. Read-only, no network.

walkthroughs.title: APK Analyzer & APK Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Look inside Android APK files without leaving VS Code.

steps.title: Open an APK
steps.description:
Click any .apk file in the Explorer: it opens in APK Analyzer. .aab, .apks and .xapk files open too. The Overview tab shows the package, versions, SDK levels, permissions and signing.
[Open the sample APK](command:apkAnalyzer.openSample)
[Open a file...](command:apkAnalyzer.open)

steps.title: Manifest, permissions and components
steps.description:
The Manifest tab shows AndroidManifest.xml decoded from binary XML. Permissions flags the dangerous ones; Components lists every activity, service, receiver and provider and whether it is exported, and why.
[Open the sample APK](command:apkAnalyzer.openSample)

steps.title: DEX method counts and APK size
steps.description:
DEX shows the method references of each classes.dex against the 65,536 limit, Packages shows the counts as a tree, and Folders and Types show where the bytes go. The hex link on the Files tab shows the unpacked bytes of any file.
[Open the sample APK](command:apkAnalyzer.openSample)

steps.title: Files that often come with Android packages
steps.description:
If your project also has archives or binary files, these free Zovo extensions open them. A link opens the extension page, and you choose there whether to install it.
[ZIP Explorer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.zip-archive-explorer%22%5D)
